interpretation: User confirmed: wide pair for all settings/popup stills; compact pair for connected/island motion. Captures alone do not establish motion; explicit user correction determines the mapping.
note: Each state has shared metric camera and assembly centers across generations. Wide still layers retain their full canvas; compact moving composition uses its separately measured centers.
spacing_rule: Center distance = canonical unit width + measured edge clearance (1.5 mm moving; 12.7 mm still). This preserves metric clearance for differently sized units.

measurements.method: Use popup width 726 px to recover metric orthographic scale from the 50.1 mm case width. Keep settings/popup the same full-canvas composition. The settings capture has different unit scale relative to case; use wide popup product scale and shared centers as requested. Bounds are manual silhouette estimates (about 2 px uncertainty).

rings.method: Static individual ring centers follow each unit silhouette horizontal midpoint; combined and case follow the metric assembly centers. Moving combined/case use moving centers.

airpods_pro_1.reference_role: User supplied old iOS front crop: spacing only, preserve current unit orientation.

airpods_pro_2.reference_role: User supplied old iOS dark popup: spacing only, preserve current unit orientation.

airpods_pro_3.reference_role: User supplied wide still popup; case width is the metric ruler.
